source: Exported from the published place (ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig, ServerScriptService.LootConfig, ServerStorage.Items) with fresh module copies
build: Published 2026-10-29 (performance, generators, hammers, ammo); values updated 2026-10-29

Baseball Bat.Description: Solid wood, taped grip. Knocks them back.

Batteries.Description: A few AA batteries. Puts charge back in your headlamp the moment you pick them up.

Crowbar.Description: Pry bar. Two swings take a plank down and you keep the wood. Works on the infected in a pinch.

Extended Battery.Description: A high-capacity battery pack for your headlamp: twice the light on a charge. Fitted on pickup.

First Aid Kit.Description: Bandages and antiseptic. Patches you up.

Freeze Device.Description: A rewired signal remote that throws a cone of killing cold. Aim and fire: every infected in front of you freezes (10 s, Brutes 6 s) and loses a quarter of its health. Recharges in 5 seconds. One per survivor.

Gun Repair Kit.Description: Oil, springs and a cleaning rod. Use it to restore your most worn gun to pristine. Only picks up if you carry a gun.

Hammer.Description: Heavy claw hammer. Slow, but it staggers what it hits and sends it flying. Builders will want one.
Hammer.ClaudeNote: ManualActivationOnly: only a quick tap swings (BuildController); a held press builds

Hunting Rifle.Description: Bolt-action hunting rifle with a scope. Uses Rifle Rounds. One per survivor, from Dr. Vance's office.

Jerry Can.Description: A red jerry can of fuel. Hold it at a generator and hold E / Square to refuel: one can runs a generator for a whole night.

LED Bulb.Description: A proper LED for your headlamp: brighter, wider, further. Fitted the moment you pick it up.

Lantern.Description: Kerosene camp lantern. Lights your way, or set it down (click) to light a room or a base. Pick it back up any time.

Machete.Description: Rusty but sharp. Hits harder than a bat.

Military Helmet.Description: Combat helmet. Hold it and press fire to wear it: takes 15% of every hit until it wears out. Only found at Blackpine Airfield.

Mini AK.Description: Compact AK-pattern carbine. Fully automatic, 20 rounds, uses Rifle Rounds. Loud. Very rare: only at Blackpine Airfield.

Plate Carrier.Description: Military plate carrier. Hold it and press fire to wear it: takes 40% of every hit until it wears out. Only found at Blackpine Airfield.

Tactical Reflector.Description: Military reflector housing. Turns your headlamp into a floodlight. Fitted the moment you pick it up.

features.name: 8-minute day, 5-minute night
features.verifiedBy: Play test: Day 1 daylight phase 440 s (+40 s dusk), night phase 300 s

features.name: Night hunting
features.verifiedBy: Play test, Night 1 in Stillwater: hunters rose 0→5→6→7→8 over 40 s, staggered; chases followed

features.name: Gunshots draw the infected
features.verifiedBy: Existing system (Zombies.noise from WeaponService: 90 studs, 120 for shotguns and loud guns); scream alerts capped

features.name: Ammo from kills
features.verifiedBy: Play test: 60 credited kills → 12 drops (20%), 20 uncredited deaths → 0; 20,000-roll distribution 18.0% / 21.4%

features.name: Green wisps
features.verifiedBy: Play test: a relic wisp led camp → crypt arch; a stash wisp left 2 items

features.name: Night caches
features.verifiedBy: Play test: 0 by day, 5 at night with glow and prompt; search gave loot

features.name: Sleep until dawn
features.verifiedBy: Play test (solo): 233 s of night left → -25 health and Dawn; infected nearby blocks it
notVerified: On-screen prompt card (capture tool doesn't draw prompt cards)

features.name: Blackpine Airfield
features.verifiedBy: Built in the published place; walked in Play; 27 containers built; 9 working doors

features.name: Soldier infected
features.verifiedBy: Play test: 5 spawned at the airfield only, 130 health, vests, 2 helmets; helmet headshot 130→45 then kill

features.name: Rare military gear director
features.verifiedBy: Play test: Day 1 rolls logged (all missed, allowed); 200,000-run simulation of the configured odds

features.name: Plate Carrier and Military Helmet
features.verifiedBy: Play test: worn via the real remote, 20-damage hit → 9 taken, durability 292/300 and 147/150, K returned both to the bag with durability
notVerified: Controller key to take armor off

features.name: Mini AK
features.verifiedBy: Play test: holding fire 1.3 s fired 12 rounds (20→8); HUD shows MINI AK / Rifle Rounds

features.name: Generators and Gas Cans
features.verifiedBy: Play test: Gas Can consumed → 300 s fuel, start lit 34 lights, burns 1 s/s; 8 gas cans, one per section, on Day 1

features.name: Spare batteries
features.verifiedBy: Play test: dead lamp swapped a spare (2→1); 1.00% drain per 6 s = 10 min; 0 drain while off; HUD shows +N BATT

features.name: Hammer: tap swings, hold builds
features.verifiedBy: Play test with mouse: 0.8–0.9 s holds caused 0 server swings; controller R2 tap swings
notVerified: Real controller R2 hold (injected input released early in testing)

features.name: No plank cap
features.verifiedBy: Server reads MaxPerPlayer = inf

features.name: Controlled loot economy (fill share, medkit/lantern/jerry-can caps)
features.verifiedBy: Studio play test 2026-10-28: 56 of 134 floor spots filled for one survivor; 1 medkit (cap 1); 1 world lantern (cap 1); 2 jerry cans at a camp shed and the airfield; used medkit replaced 137 studs away; taken lantern replaced

features.name: Airfield rare gear: one or two categories a day
features.verifiedBy: 100,000-day simulation of the live selection: 0 / 50.1% / 49.9% / 0 days with 0/1/2/3 categories; each category ~50%; live run placed Mini AK and Plate Carrier on airfield floor spots

features.name: Duplicate melee pickups repair and toughen
features.verifiedBy: Studio: Hammer 40/160 -> 168/168 on a duplicate; capped at 200 (125%) after 8 more

features.name: Melee weapons break a pane in one hit
features.verifiedBy: Studio: one Machete swing broke a House_Elm1 pane

features.name: Gun Repair Kit
features.verifiedBy: Studio: pickup refused without a gun, accepted with one; Pistol 30/160 -> 160/160, kit used up

features.name: Generators need a jerry can in hand (airfield and ranger station)
features.verifiedBy: Studio: no start without fuel; can in bag refused; can in hand +300 s; ranger station lights on; no drain while stopped

features.name: Freeze Device
features.verifiedBy: Studio: one claim per player; cone hit 4 of 9 (in-cone, clear line); walls, behind, out-of-range untouched; 25% damage; walker thawed at 10.1 s, Brute 6.1 s; 24/100 walker killed

features.name: Hunting Rifle case: one claim per player
features.verifiedBy: Studio: first claim gave the rifle and 5 rounds; second refused; refused again after the rifle was lost

features.name: Ritual reward: night-vision goggles rise from the circle
features.verifiedBy: Studio: circle glow, goggles rose to 3.25 studs and bobbed/turned; claim set NVG and the HUD pill read NVG ON; second claim refused

features.name: Generators: one prompt, refuel then start/stop
features.verifiedBy: Studio 2026-10-29, real held key input: refuel +300 s and can removed; hold started and stopped; early release and mid-pour unequip used nothing; auto-stop at empty; ranger station refuel and start, 8 lights
